//: Examining a rippling wall on Level 0.

condition.u_query: The wall ripples like cloth in a draft.  Step through it?

false_effect.u_message: You step back.  The wall goes still.

//: Level 0 -> Level 1. You land under where you were. If no arrival alcove is close, one forms around you. Followers within 20 tiles come along. Every move after the dimension change stays inside the loaded map, so followers are never left behind.

effect.fail_message: You press against the wall.  It's just a wall.
effect.success_message: You fall through the wall and land hard on cold, damp concrete.

effect.//: Level 1 only has floor at ground level (z 0); every other level is solid rock. Drop to ground level first, straight down or up, which stays inside the loaded map.
Find the nearest rippling concrete (old or new alcoves alike) and land on the tile just inside it (south of it). Only build a new alcove if none is within 30 tiles.

//: Once per world, on the first trip into Level 1: turn a garage square 4-10 squares away into the Breakroom hub and mark it on the map. 4+ keeps it outside the loaded area, so it is generated fresh with its NPCs.

effect.u_message: Scrawled on the nearest pillar in fresh marker: an arrow, and the word BREAKROOM.  Someone down here is still keeping order.  You note the direction on your map.

//: No arrival alcove nearby: build one in the map square you landed in, then point at its landing tile.
Run on each NPC in the reality bubble: followers join the player at the arrival point. force_safe puts each one on the nearest free tile instead of on top of someone.

false_effect.u_message: You step back.  The concrete goes still.

effect.success_message: You stumble out onto damp yellow carpet.  The hum of the lights is almost welcome.
